ministries and agencies; described as unstable, unreliable and hardly used
rolled out to a limited number of ministries and agencies using broadband

note: No local government office is said to be connected. The policy (June 2020) calls the government network unfit for purpose and hardly used by ministries and agencies, and sets targets for 2024 to expand broadband to all local government areas and districts and to give every public institution, government buildings included, at least 5 Mbps: targets for areas and public institutions, not a stated connection of council offices. Local authorities (BCC, KMC, BAC) appear only as issuers of permits and fees. The capture is truncated in section 11.6.
